1.headline: Beauty Brands Are Spending 40% More This Quarter
1.subheadline: Q1 2025 is shaping up to be the best quarter for beauty creators in 3 years.
keyPoints: Average deal size up from $2,800 to $3,900
1.takeaway: If you're in beauty, now is the time to pitch. Brands have budget to spend.
1.author: Haus Research

2.headline: The "Perpetuity" Trap Is Back
2.subheadline: Brands are hiding unlimited usage rights in new contract language.
keyPoints: Watch for "for the duration of the campaign"
"Across all media" = they can use it anywhere forever
Always ask for specific end dates in writing
2.takeaway: Never sign without a usage expiration date. 12-24 months is standard.
2.author: Legal Team

3.headline: How Top Creators Get 3x Their Initial Offers
3.subheadline: The negotiation framework that's working right now.
3.takeaway: Brands expect you to negotiate. The first offer is never the best offer.
3.author: Sarah Chen

4.headline: TikTok Shop Commissions Dropping to 2%
4.subheadline: March changes will hit most creators hard.
4.takeaway: Diversify now. Direct brand deals should be your primary income.
4.author: Haus Research

5.headline: From $500 to $15K: One Creator's Journey
5.subheadline: Mike stopped saying yes to everything.
keyPoints: Turned down 80% of deals for 6 months
5.takeaway: Being selective builds your perceived value.
5.author: Mike Johnson
